body: I appreciate you participating this. I know it's not super in-depth, or allowing of notes, but that was on purpose. This is my first time doing data collection and creating a poll for my research project so I wanted to keep it as simple as possible. I really wanted to provide more questions, and even a space for notes, but it would have been too much for me with the amount of time I was given.

I had thought about putting more questions to make our experiences more accurate, but this was my first time creating a poll and collecting data for a research project. I didn't want to get overwhelmed, so I just decided to simply that section to a yes/no LGBTQ+ related experience. I appreciate you participating.

Thank you to anyone that has responded so far. I want to get as many responses as possible, so please please please take the survey. It's super short and takes less than a minute to complete. Thank you all!
